name: Refuses work that is not a Task

item_template.title: Add a loading spinner to the settings page
item_template.description: The page flashes blank while data loads.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the page is loading, when it renders, then a spinner is shown.

notes: PO Writer's kind guard: it scopes Tasks and refuses anything else. A `done` here means the guard is gone and it has started slicing sub-tasks off a sub-task.

name: Asks rather than inventing a feature

item_template.title: Make the app better
item_template.description: It should be nicer to use.

notes: The `ambiguous-must-escalate` trap, as a single-agent test. `done` is the FAILING result: an agent that scopes a feature out of this invented it. A framework that can only assert success cannot express that.
